title: 第四章：推倒重盖
content_zh:
第(1/3)页

苏行枫回到家后，正好户外用品店送货的就到了山脚下，还好的是他们那辆小货车可以开上山。让他们把货放在院子里，卸完货后送货的人就走了，而他就把那一堆堆的货全收进戒子里。

刚收完户外店的货，这边又来了超市配送的货，这是他买的锅碗瓢盆和一些食材，一共来了三批送货的，一个上午就在这收货，直到所有东西都收完后这才休息了一下。

“行枫，行枫你在家吗？”

“在呢！等我一下，我就出来。”

他累了一上午，这正吃完饭趟在客厅休息呢，这时村长从山下爬上山叫嚷着，还不还在断的喘着粗气呢。

“村长啊！看你这累得，来进来喝口水”

他看到村长在那插着腰，抹着汉笑着把他迎进家。

“哎！我这不是不会用智能手机嘛！一下玩得就没电了，正好上面有个通知下来，所以就跑来通知你一下，你这山路我那小车我不敢开啊！这不，只能停在山下自己爬上来啊”

“有什么重要通知非得你自己亲自走一趟，你让安子他们来就可以了啊！”

“上头有个通知，说是每个村有一两个名额可以让自己村里选出村官。你不是刚退伍回来吗？，这还是党员啊！以你的条件不用走后门都可以入选啊！所以我这不是急嘛！”

“村官啊！那还是算了吧！这个让我整天在村里跑来跑去的真不是个事，你还是看看其他人吧！你家安子不是正合适嘛？他刚大学毕业，现在不是正没事做嘛！你就让他去吧！”

“怎么说话的呢？这可是村官呢！以后做得好了可以到县里市里去呢！到时候可是当大官的啊！要不是德财老哥走的早，他要是听你这么说非打死你不可，我们自家人，叔我接到通知第一个想到的就是你”

这时村长严肃的对他说。而村长提到的德财老哥正是苏行枫的爷爷，他爷爷在村里还是挺有威望的。本来这村的村长以前是他爷爷当选的，可是因为要照顾自己，他爷爷就把这村长的位置提选给了现在的村长，所以两家感情就更重了些。

“富贵叔，我真不想参合这事，我有自己的打算。你对我的照顾我在这先谢谢了，你还是让安子去吧！安子现在的情况你自己知道，比起以前那是好太多了，你让他去做这个村官这不是正好套住他了吗？你也不想让他再回到以前那样整天无所事是的吧？”

“这...你就不再了解一下再说？”

“不用了，我又不是不知道，以前在部队时我们还是会学习政~治的嘛！我这性格根本就不适合做干这行啊！”

村长坐在那盯着他看了看，一脸的可惜，从他自己心里觉得苏行枫要是能当上这个村官，在他的帮助下和苏行枫自己的努力下定能到县里的，可是现在苏行枫根本就不感兴趣。

“哎！那好吧！这事就在这星期内定下来，如果你要是改变主意了上家里找我，安子的事我自有打算，我也不能让他这么玩下去了，你们年青人更能谈得来，有时间你也说说那小子。”

“考虑就算了，安子你先安排着，我这边也会跟他聊聊。谢谢了富贵叔”

“这孩子，自家人还谢什么，我也没别的事了，那就先下去了。”

说完村长就起身，可是这还没走呢，苏行枫就按住他又坐了下来。

“富贵叔，走这么快干什么呢？我这还有件事找你谈一下呢！”他一本正经的说。

“你还有什么事要和我说啊？你不是整天在你这山里搞这搞那的，你还有什么事？”

“我，算了不和你老挣。我是想把这院子堆倒重新盖过，你也看到了，爷爷他走了两三年而那时我也还在部队，这房子长时间没人住，那边不是倒了一间嘛！我这段时候联系了材料就是想把这重新弄一下，就是想问一下这事村里要不要什么手续什么的？”

“推倒重盖？”

Page (1/3)

After Su Xingfeng returned home, it happened that the outdoor goods store delivered goods to the foot of the mountain. Fortunately, their small truck could drive up the mountain.Let them put the goods in the yard. After unloading the goods, the delivery person left, and he put all the piles of goods into the ring.

He had just finished collecting the goods from the outdoor store, and here came the goods delivered by the supermarket. These were the pots, pans, pans and some ingredients he bought. There were three batches of deliveries in total. He spent the whole morning collecting goods here, and only took a break after everything was collected.

"Xing Feng, Xing Feng, are you at home?"

"Here! Wait for me and I'll come out."

He was tired all morning and was resting in the living room after dinner. At this time, the village chief climbed up the mountain and shouted, still breathing heavily.

"Village Chief! Seeing how tired you are, come in and have a drink of water."

He saw the village chief there with his hands on his waist, wiping his hair and smiling as he welcomed him into his home.

"Hey! I don't know how to use a smartphone! I ran out of battery while playing, and there happened to be a notification on it, so I came to tell you that I don't dare to drive my little car on your mountain road! No, I can only park at the bottom of the mountain and climb up by myself."

"If there is any important notice, you must go there yourself. Just ask Anzi and the others to come!"

"There is a notice from above, saying that each village has one or two quotas for its own village to elect village officials. Didn't you just come back from the army? You are still a party member! With your conditions, you can be selected without going through the back door! So I'm not in a hurry!"

"Village official! Let's forget it! This thing that makes me run around the village all day is really not a problem. You should look at other people! Isn't your Anzi just the right one? He just graduated from college and has nothing to do now! Just let him go!"

"How are you talking? This is a village official! If you do well in the future, you can go to the county or city! He will be a senior official then! If Brother Decai hadn't left early, he would have beaten you to death if he heard what you said. As a member of our own family, the first thing I thought of when I received the notice was you."

At this time, the village chief said to him seriously.The elder Decai mentioned by the village chief was Su Xingfeng's grandfather, and his grandfather was quite prestigious in the village.Originally, his grandfather was elected as the village chief, but because he had to take care of himself, his grandfather nominated the village chief's position to the current village chief, so the relationship between the two families became even stronger.

"Uncle Fugui, I really don't want to get involved in this matter. I have my own plans. Thank you in advance for taking care of me. You'd better let Anzi go! You know Anzi's current situation. It's much better than before. Isn't it just a trap for you to let him be the village official? You don't want him to go back to doing nothing all day long like before, right?"

"This...don't you want to understand it for a while?"

"No, it's not like I don't know. We still studied politics when we were in the army! My personality is not suitable for this job at all!"

The village chief sat there and stared at him with a look of pity on his face. From his own heart, he felt that if Su Xingfeng could become the village official, with his help and Su Xingfeng's own efforts, he would definitely be able to go to the county, but now Su Xingfeng was not interested at all.

"Hey! Okay! The matter will be settled within this week. If you change your mind and come to see me at home, I have my own plans for Anzi. I can't let him play like this anymore. You young people can talk better. You can also talk about that kid when you have time."

"Forget it, Anzi, you can make arrangements first, and I will also talk to him here. Thank you, Uncle Fugui."

"This kid, I have nothing to thank my family for. I don't have anything else to do, so I'll go down first."

After saying this, the village chief stood up, but before he left, Su Xingfeng held him down and sat down again.

"Uncle Fugui, why are you leaving so fast? I have something else to discuss with you!" He said seriously.

"What else do you want to tell me? You don't spend all day doing this and that in your mountains, what else do you have to do?"

"I, forget it, I won't keep making money with you. I just want to demolish this yard and build it again. As you can see, grandpa left for two or three years and I was still in the army at that time. This house has been unoccupied for a long time, so one room was demolished over there! I contacted the materials at this time just to redo it. I just wanted to ask if there are any procedures in the village for this matter?"

"Tear it down and replace it?"
